extensionDescription.message: A free GitHub contribution visualizer. Turn real daily contributions into a city.

zoomFitHelp.message: Starts at 100%; minimum 50%, maximum 2000%. Click “Fit view” to zoom out and center the city.

canvasLabel.message: Contribution City. Fixed view. Drag to pan and scroll to zoom.

readingRange.message: Reading $1. Your city fills as data arrives…

invalidRange.message: The start year must not be later than the end year.

noDates.message: No dates are available for the selected years.

cancelledDetail.message: Loading was cancelled. The field is incomplete.

readFailedDetail.message: Could not load contributions. Please retry.

cityOpenError.message: Could not open City. Refresh the page or reload CodeYears. You can return to Contributions.

confirmingClear.message: Confirming your identity and clearing this profile’s cache…

cacheClearedDetail.message: Cleared this visitor’s yearly cache for this profile.

viewHelp.message: Drag to pan and scroll to zoom. “Fit view” restores the full city. Data fills the field as it arrives; unavailable areas remain empty. Frame your view, then right-click the canvas and choose “Save image as…” or “Copy image”.

dataHelp.message: Data stays on this device, separated by visitor and profile. Years use complete ISO weeks: Monday–Sunday belongs to the year containing Thursday. Adjacent calendar years may be requested at the boundary, so totals can differ from GitHub’s calendar-year totals. Missing and future dates are never filled with zeros.

identityUnknown.message: Identity unknown; cache is not used

languageSaveError.message: Could not save the language preference. Please retry.

legendLevels.message: Fixed levels use real daily counts. Adjacent cells in the same level may merge into supported footprints, so one building can represent several dates. Single-storey homes stay on single cells.

legendWonders.message: Sustained dense contributions can become a stadium, theater or landmark park, with up to two wonders per year. Their larger footprints represent density and preserve every date and count. A landmark park is not a low-contribution grass tile.

legendNature.message: Zero-count tiles follow their surroundings: grass, trees or ponds in open areas; paving or plazas in dense urban areas. Colors are material variations. Rivers, bank trees, roads, signals and vehicles are decoration, not contribution types.

legendMissing.message: Dates that have not arrived, and future dates, remain unfilled. They are not zero contributions.

popupWrongPage.message: Open a GitHub profile first, then click CodeYears.

popupNotReady.message: Retry after the contribution calendar has loaded on the GitHub profile.

popupFailed.message: Could not open City. Refresh the GitHub profile and retry.

errNoYears.message: No yearly contribution links were found on this page.

errProfilePage.message: Open a GitHub profile and wait for its contribution calendar to load.

errGrid.message: A unique contribution calendar was not found. Your session or GitHub’s page structure may have changed.

errHeading.message: The yearly heading could not be read. Only GitHub’s English yearly format has been validated.

errYearTotal.message: The yearly total is not a valid integer.

errTooltip.message: A date tooltip is bound more than once.

errDateFormat.message: The contribution date format is not supported.

errDateRange.message: The calendar contains duplicate or out-of-range dates.

errContextChanged.message: The profile or visitor has changed. Refresh the page and reopen City.

errIdentityChanged.message: The current GitHub identity could not be confirmed or has changed. Old cache was not used. Refresh and retry.

warnCacheRead.message: The cache could not be read. Fetching from GitHub instead.

warnIdentity.message: Visitor identity is unknown. Cache is not read or written.

warnCacheWrite.message: Real data was loaded but could not be cached. It is available on this page only.

errClearIdentity.message: Identity is unknown, so the cache scope cannot be selected for clearing.

errRedirect.message: The request was redirected. Check your GitHub session and retry.

errResponse.message: GitHub returned an unsupported response format.

errAssets.message: City assets could not be loaded. Please retry.

errAssetsRetry.message: City assets could not be loaded. Please retry.

errCanvas.message: Could not create a city asset canvas.

errGraphics.message: The graphics context was interrupted. Please retry.

errLandscape.message: The landscape could not be loaded. Please retry.

errNetwork.message: The network request failed. Check your connection and retry.

warnYearBoundary.message: Available source years do not cover the full boundary. Only provided dates are shown.

errProfileMismatch.message: Contribution profile does not match requested profile.

errHTTP.message: GitHub request failed (HTTP $1). The failed response was not treated as empty data.

errParseDay.message: Could not accurately parse the count or date text for $1. Color levels were not used to estimate it.

errDayCount.message: The count for $1 is not a valid non-negative integer.

errCoverage.message: Incomplete yearly coverage: received $1 days, expected $2. Missing dates were not filled with zeros.

errTotalMismatch.message: Daily total $1 does not match the page’s yearly total $2. Accuracy could not be confirmed.

keyboardControls.message: Focus the city and use arrow keys to pan, + to zoom in, and - to zoom out.

canvasKeyboardLabel.message: Contribution City. Use arrow keys or drag to pan, and +, - or the scroll wheel to zoom.

settingsHelp.message: Preferences apply in this browser. Year and view controls stay on the GitHub profile.

townLegendHeading.message: Reading the town · daily means and craftsmanship

townLegendRustic.message: Simple timber, thatch and practical fittings

townLegendWorkshop.message: Fine masonry, crafted roofs and ornament

townLegendArcane.message: Carved porches, lavish roofs and magical gardens

townLegendRegions.message: Adjacent dates with similar contributions form a building plot. Its mean daily contributions guide materials, craftsmanship and luxury; height follows the building form and does not encode contribution strength. A main building, its own garden and supporting facilities occupy the plot together. Small buildings receive courtyard walls when needed.

townLegendLife.message: Residents, animals, flowering trees, mana wells and waygates bring the town to life. They do not count people, projects or contributions. Hover a contribution building for its actual member dates and available project activity.

roadsLocal.message: Destinations are saved in this browser. Only you can edit your city’s roads.

roadInvalidUsername.message: Enter a GitHub username (up to 39 letters, digits or single hyphens).

roadDuplicate.message: A road to this account already exists.

roadsReadError.message: Could not read saved roads. Retry to manage them.

roadsSaveError.message: Could not save this change. Your saved roads have been kept.

roadEditHint.message: Right-click or press Shift+F10 to edit the destination

roadReturnHint.message: Right-click or press Shift+F10 for all return routes

returnRoadLocal.message: These return routes follow your visits in this tab. They do not change this city’s exits.

roadsOwnerOnly.message: Only the signed-in owner can edit this city’s roads.

roadOwnerCheckFailed.message: Could not confirm your identity and save the road. The previous settings have been kept.

roadTravelError.message: Could not save the return route. Please try again.
